text:
maria: Quick heads-up — All-hands Friday Aug 11 10:00 PT. We're doing an offsite recap + policy updates + product roadmap. Please drop one-line Qs by Wed EOD. Plan: ~50m updates + 20m live Q&A.

maria: High-level agenda:
• 10:00 — CEO offsite recap (key themes + org priorities)
• 10:12 — Product: roadmap highlights + Dedicated availability window
• 10:28 — Eng: incident TL;DR and reliability next-steps
• 10:36 — Compliance: data-retention & hosted logs policy update (legal-bot will summarize)
• 10:44 — People Ops: hiring + benefits follow-up
• 10:50 — Short customer highlight (1 min)
• 10:52 — Live Q&A (20m)

maria: Slides + run-of-show (internal): https://redwood.app/s/allhands_aug11

ethan: One-liner: "Can Product commit to a target week for Dedicated GA and what will be gated?"

priya: One-liner: "Will the new hosted-logs retention change affect compliance customers' export windows?"

jamal: One-liner: "Can Eng share the short post-incident mitigation steps and whether we changed the SRE on-call model?"

lina: One-liner: "Will there be a public changelog for the policy changes and a heads-up cadence for customers?"

maria: Good Qs. Legal-bot will cover the retention bullets (priya) and Product will take the GA gating (ethan). Jamal, Eng will give a 90s TL;DR and note any on-call adjustments. Lina, we'll confirm changelog cadence.

legal-bot: Draft policy blurb: "Hosted logs retention will default to 90 days starting Sep 30. Customers with compliance needs can request custom retention (up to 3 years) via support; export tooling will be available 30 days prior to enforcement."

priya: Thx — can Legal-bot include the export API endpoint details in the post-meeting FAQ?

legal-bot: Will add export endpoint and support flow to the FAQ doc after legal sign-off.

maria: Townhall logistics: Zoom link in calendar invite, captioning enabled on request. Recording will be posted to Drive and a short FAQ published in #all-hands with links to slides and policy docs.

townhall-bot: Calendar event created: Aug 11 10:00 PT — All-hands / Offsite Recap & Policy Update — https://calendar.redwood/ev/2789

maria: Pre-meeting action items:
• Product (ethan): finalize GA target & gating bullets
• Eng (jamal): prepare 90s incident TL;DR + any on-call changes
• Legal/Compliance (legal-bot): finalize retention blurb + FAQ draft
• CS (lina): customer highlight slide + changelog cadence note

ethan: I'll post the GA bullets by Wednesday noon.

jamal: I'll upload the incident TL;DR and note the on-call proposal to run-of-show by Thursday.

lina: Customer highlight slide incoming; will propose a monthly changelog cadence.

maria: Key messages we want to land:
• Clear timeline and gates for Dedicated GA
• Transparent policy change + support path for compliance customers
• Evidence of incident follow-ups and concrete reliability steps
• One customer win to celebrate from offsite

maria: If you have sensitive Qs, DM me or put them in #exec-private. We'll curate and surface a short Q list at start of meeting.

ethan: FYI — we should reserve 3 minutes to call out migration/rollback plan for the retention changes (customers will ask).

maria: Good call — adding a 2-min migration checklist to the Compliance segment.

priya: Please enable live captions for accessibility.

maria: Done — captions will be enabled.

maria: Thanks everyone — see you Fri Aug 11 10:00 PT. Recording + FAQ posted after. :sparkles:
